Builds hom sets and normalizes composition by overriding identity entries and filling unique hom sets. Identity detection depends on id-prefixed names or first endomorphism. Explicit contradictory identity entries are erased before validation, and typed closure, duplicate labels and unknown endpoints are incompletely checked. Associativity enumeration is meaningful only after these input assumptions.

Exhausts cones and unique mediators for terminal, product, equalizer and pullback constructions under valid input assumptions. Product legs keyed by object names collapse repeated objects: an independently built 15-arrow category has A x A = P but returns no product. Diagram shape, parallelism and typing are not separately enforced. All 342 meet/join comparisons on 19 three-object posets agree.

Computes colimits by category duality and adjunction by hom-cardinality screen plus enumeration of natural transformations and triangle identities. Conditional on valid functors, this is finite exhaustive search. Functor laws are never checked, and unknown colimit shapes return absence. Shared dependence on limits and category normalization prevents independent validation.

Routes finite tasks after normalized category validation; returns witnesses or absence using shared routines. Does not validate diagram or functor laws or enforce stated object/morphism ceilings. Unsupported colimit shape becomes DOES_NOT_EXIST; LIMIT unknown becomes UNKNOWN. Trace is a fixed list of stage letters, not measured descent.

Read all 948 lines. Constructs 40 base, 16 controls and 8 poisons and writes on import, so not executed. Base35 and base40 reversed-order maps are not functors, although labelled non-adjoint; eight gauge adjunctions differ only case IDs. Comments on base28 mappings differ from actual valid Galois maps. Poison 64 comment mentions identity preservation but data actually lacks a composite. Examples are curated declarations, not independent ground truth.

Creates 48 mutations in six limited classes and writes on import. Despite docstring, no validator is invoked to establish rejection. Fake names exercise membership but miss wrong existing apex, valid-named wrong legs, nonnatural adjunction components and repeated objects. Root test already xfails the secondary mutation check.

Creates twelve public cases and derives expected answers directly from owner solve; not independent truth. Includes a nontrivial monoid no-product case but no existing repeated-object product. Writes legacy demos path, so not executed during source-preserving audit.

Compares statuses/kinds and sometimes exact apex or OOS reason against owner-generated expected data; it does not validate universal legs, mediator uniqueness, naturality or triangles. Exits nonzero on aggregate mismatch, but passing this runner is an example regression only.

Sibling tests run owner reference and both checkers on retained cases/mutations. Secondary mutation rejection is explicitly xfailed; tests do not independently establish mathematical truth or cover valid-name false witnesses. Audit probes were independently constructed rather than inheriting supplied expected labels.

Equational proof by contextual axiom instances is sound only when substitutions bind variables, not ground constants; a countermodel needs total closed operations and universal axiom satisfaction. The planned Rust/Python dual checker, lemma chains, 200-step capability, 36 base plus12 controls plus8 poisons, and provider/prover comparisons are not established by delivered Python implementations or retained examples.

Explicitly distinguishes variable strings x,y,z from ground constants a,b,e and promises universal axiom evaluation for models. Implementations substitute every atomic string and incompletely validate model domains. Position syntax is nonnegative argument indexing; secondary negative-index behavior violates it. Output examples and contract do not prove runtime soundness.

Checks ID and shallow equation pair syntax, replays each claimed axiom step and final endpoint, and calls the owner finite-model evaluator. It does not enforce variable-only substitutions, term/signature well-formedness, arities/bounds or lemma proofs. Bool is accepted as int for indices/size. OUT_OF_SCOPE checks only the envelope, ignoring witness detail. Direct proof and countermodel counterexamples are recorded.

Reimplements substitution and positions but shares the constant-substitution flaw; negative positions can modify operator symbols and non-lr directions act as reverse. Countermodel branch tests only goal inequality and ignores every axiom, table closure/shape, constants, bool types and missing operations. Thus independent authorship does not establish an independent semantic gate.
Exports owner solve only; no external prover, Rust replayer or independent validation is added.

Matcher recognizes a fixed lexical variable convention and preserves constants, but apply_subst and rewrite_step replace every string named in a supplied map, without checking variable membership. Position navigation in the primary correctly rejects negative/out-of-bounds children. Terms lack recursive grammar and signature checks. This is matching rather than general unification.

Bidirectional breadth-first exploration stores complete paths, reverses backward step directions and splices at identical JSON terms; bounded at depth/node ceilings and returns None on search exhaustion. Extra variables on replacement sides remain lexical variables rather than enumerated ground instances, limiting completeness. On nine unary axiom pairs and nine ground goals, 47 emitted proofs replay independently and have no two-element countermodels. This does not establish general completeness or long-chain capability.

Primary enumerates all lexical axiom-variable assignments and requires goal inequality; constants must be present and in range. It coerces bool/string/float entries to ints and never checks operation dimensions or closure. Thus f(0)=1 in a claimed singleton domain passes. Finder only searches sizes2..3 and unary/binary operations, eagerly materializes tables, ignores signature consistency and cannot certify absence of larger models.

Validates equation envelopes only, searches proof depth 5/nodes2000 then models through size 3, and returns budget-coded UNKNOWN if neither found. The budget code is a search ceiling, not provider accounting. Trace CRIET is fixed stage metadata without obstruction values. It does not replay a produced proof before emitting or implement lemma storage/conversion.

Read all410 lines. Actual split26+10+16+12 differs from planned26+10+12+8. Most named group/lattice/combinator theorems are direct supplied axioms or short instances, not the promised right-group-law derivations. Relabel controls only reverse goals or axioms; symbols are not renamed. z is used in goals despite lexical variable convention and ground-goal contract. Labels are not independently generated by a second checker. No writes executed.

Generates48 syntactic corruptions in8 groups without running either checker. Model corruptions only cover trivial goal equality and size99, missing violated axioms, out-of-domain entries and Boolean values. No self-referential lemma tests or constant-binding substitutions, despite planned gates. Files are written on import, so source-preserving audit did not run generator.

Defines12 bare input examples and writes them on import; contrary to planned worked chains, includes no output proof chains or long group consequences and replaces UNKNOWN with reflexivity. Nonassociative magma example is not a nonassociative loop. Data labels are not independent mathematical certification.

Counts any SOLVED or OUT_OF_SCOPE response as a pass without calling a checker or comparing expected truth. An empty example directory passes0/0. Public runner success therefore supplies no certificate soundness evidence.

Checks64 retained cases and48 mutations with both owner checkers, but the finite mutation families miss constant substitution, operation closure and axiom-ignoring defects. Counts differ from planned packet. Fresh bounded audit independently checks generated certificates and adversarial cases; retained test labels alone are not proof.
